test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: By selling cloth at ₹344/m, a shopkeeper loses 57%. Find the rate (in ₹/m) at which it should be sold so as to earn a profit of 71%.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Loss of 57% means **SP₁** is 43% of CP (100% − 57% = 43%).

Profit of 71% means **SP₂** is 171% of CP (100% + 71% = 171%).

Ratio of selling prices SP₁ : SP₂ = 43 : 171.

Given 43 units = ₹344, then 1 unit = 344 ÷ 43 = 8.

New selling price (171 units) = 171 × 8 = ₹1,368.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,368/m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** SP₁ = ₹344, Loss% = 57%, Target Profit% = 71%.

**Formulas:** CP = SP × 100 ÷ (100 − Loss%) | SP = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c6c6e8813810d811fc5d3f7ead1509efca68a269189855f1b524d7f18894f99.png] 

⇒ Step 1: Find **Cost Price (CP)** = 344 × 100 ÷ (100 − 57) = 344 × 100 ÷ 43.

⇒ Step 2: CP = 8 × 100 = **₹800**.

⇒ Step 3: Find **New SP** = 800 × (100 + 71) ÷ 100 = 800 × 171 ÷ 100.

⇒ Step 4: New SP = 8 × 171 = **₹1,368**.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,368/m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Direct SP Formula

When CP is constant: SP₂ = SP₁ × (100 + Profit₂%) ÷ (100 ± Profit/Loss₁%).

Percentage Change

Calculating the **multiplication factor** (1.71 ÷ 0.43 = 4) can simplify multi-step profit/loss problems involving the same base **Cost Price**.
